PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.title: The Philosophers' Gaze
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.INITIAL.descript: Beyond Neow's threshold, old teachings turn their attention toward you. One may guide the first steps of this climb, or you may walk on unaided.
Accept neither Muduo nor Green Jade Pendant.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.KONGZI_MUDUO.des: The wooden tongue sounds once. You carry the order of ritual into the Spire.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.KONGZI_QING_YU_P: The jade's quiet warmth settles in your hand. You carry benevolence into the Spire.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.DECLINE.descript: You bow without accepting a teaching. The way ahead remains your own.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.CONTINUATION.des: A new Act unfolds before you. Your earlier choice receives an answer. Accept one legacy, or move on.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.CONTINUATION.opt: Accept neither Bear Paw nor Ink Line.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MENGZI_XIONG_ZHA: You choose what is right. Bear Paw settles into your hand.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.XUNZI_SHENG_MO.d: The inked cord pulls taut. Your measure is set.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.CONTINUATION_DEC: You decline the legacy and enter the new Act alone.
